messages:
sara: Quick nudge — I pushed the candidate branch for v1.14.0 and locally made an annotated tag (v1.14.0). Need someone to push the annotated tag + create a draft GitHub release with artifacts. Cutoff for docs sync is in ~2 hours.

release-bot: Build artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-release-artifacts/v1.14.0/ (sha abc123). CI: ✅ all checks green.

jun: I left a changelog snippet in the PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123) but didn't merge the file. Can someone copy that into CHANGELOG.md for the release notes?

mike: I can do the GH side. Plan: push annotated tag and create draft. Command I'll run:
```
git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "v1.14.0 release"
git push origin v1.14.0
# then
gh release create v1.14.0 ./artifacts --title "v1.14.0" --notes-file ./CHANGELOG.md --draft
```
I'll wait for someone to confirm the changelog is finalized and that the release notes should be the full CHANGELOG.md or trimmed notes.

olivia: I'll do a quick smoke test against the dedicated staging cluster once the tag is pushed. Ping me when done and I'll run the basic end-to-end checklist. :white_check_mark:

sara: Prefer trimmed notes (highlights). Jun — can you post the short highlights here? Also reminder: update infra tags for docker images — build pipeline created images with tag v1.14.0-20260317.

jun: Highlights: 'improved batching heuristics', 'kv cache fixes', 'GRPC connection pooling', added metrics for per-model cost. Short bullet list:
- Improved dynamic batching (reduced p99 by ~20%)
- Fix: KV cache invalidation race
- GRPC pooling for backend RPCs
- Expose per-model cost metric in /metrics

mike: Got it. I'll assemble the trimmed notes and then push tag + create draft. Doing the push in ~5m. :rocket:

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: if no publish within 12h, auto-fallback will roll to v1.13.4. Use `@release-bot publish v1.14.0` to trigger CI publish.

mike: Pushed annotated tag and created draft release (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.14.0). Draft notes uploaded with highlights. Leaving it in draft — olivia, kick off smoke now? 

olivia: Running smoke. Will report back in ~10m.

olivia: Smoke done. All good on staging. :thumbsup: No regressions on basic prompts. Suggest we merge changelog PR and then set release to public.

sara: Thanks team. Jun can you merge the changelog PR now? I'll flip the release from draft to published after merge and confirm infra tags.

jun: Merged changelog PR. 

mike: Published release and triggered docker publish. CI build for docker images started (workflow 9876). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/9876

sara: Excellent. Tagging complete. Recording for the release notes doc.
